Boaz@1Ki.7.21-2Ch.description: Boaz was the name given to one of the two bronze pillars that stood at the entrance of Solomon's Temple (<ref="1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17">1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17</ref>).
Boaz@1Ki.7.21-2Ch.name: Boaz

Boaz@Rut.2.1-Luk.description: Boaz, a wealthy Bethlehemite, married Ruth and became an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.
Boaz@Rut.2.1-Luk.name: Boaz

Bocheru@1Ch.8.38-.description: Bocheru was a son of Azel and a descendant of King Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.
Bocheru@1Ch.8.38-.name: Bocheru

Bohan@Jos.15.6-.description: Bohan, son of Reuben, was the namesake of a boundary stone between the territories of Judah and Benjamin.
Bohan@Jos.15.6-.name: Bohan

Booths_Festival@Jhn.7.2.description: The Booths_Festival, also known as the Feast of Tabernacles or Sukkot, was a Jewish festival commemorating the Israelites' wilderness wanderings and God's provision (<ref="Jhn.7.2">Jhn.7.2</ref>).
Booths_Festival@Jhn.7.2.name: Booths_Festival

Bor-ashan@1Sa.30.30.description: Bor-ashan, a town in southern Judah, was one of the places where David sent spoils from his victory over the Amalekites.
Bor-ashan@1Sa.30.30.name: Bor-ashan

Bozez@1Sa.14.4.description: Bozez, one of the rocky crags that Jonathan and his armor-bearer crossed to attack the Philistine garrison.
Bozez@1Sa.14.4.name: Bozez

Bozkath@Jos.15.39-2Ki.description: Bozkath was a town in Judah and the birthplace of King Josiah's mother, Jedidah.
Bozkath@Jos.15.39-2Ki.name: Bozkath

Bozrah@Gen.36.33-Amo.description: Bozrah was an important city in Edom, often mentioned in prophecies of judgment.
Bozrah@Gen.36.33-Amo.name: Bozrah

Broad_Wall@Neh.3.8-.description: The Broad Wall was a section of Jerusalem's wall rebuilt during Nehemiah's time.
Broad_Wall@Neh.3.8-.name: Broad_Wall

Brook_of_Egypt@Num.34.5-Ezk.description: The Brook of Egypt (Shihor) marked the southwestern boundary of the Promised Land.
Brook_of_Egypt@Num.34.5-Ezk.name: Brook_of_Egypt

Brook_of_the_Arabah@Amo.6.14.description: The Brook of the Arabah was the eastern boundary of King Jeroboam II's kingdom.
Brook_of_the_Arabah@Amo.6.14.name: Brook_of_the_Arabah

Brook_of_the_Willows@Isa.15.7.description: The Brook of the Willows was a boundary of Moab's territory, possibly near the Wadi Zered.
Brook_of_the_Willows@Isa.15.7.name: Brook_of_the_Willows

Bukki@1Ch.6.5-Ezr.description: Bukki, a high priest, was the son of Abishua and the father of Uzzi in the lineage of Aaron.
Bukki@1Ch.6.5-Ezr.name: Bukki

Bukki@Num.34.22.description: Bukki, the son of Jogli, was a prince of the tribe of Dan chosen to help divide the Promised Land.
Bukki@Num.34.22.name: Bukki

Bukkiah@1Ch.25.4-.description: Bukkiah, a Levite and descendant of Heman, was a musician in the temple during David's reign.
Bukkiah@1Ch.25.4-.name: Bukkiah

Bul@1Ki.6.38.description: Bul, mentioned in <ref="1Ki.6.38">1Ki.6.38</ref>, is the eighth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to October-November in the modern calendar.
Bul@1Ki.6.38.name: Bul

Bunah@1Ch.2.25.description: Bunah was a son of Jerahmeel and a descendant of Judah.
Bunah@1Ch.2.25.name: Bunah

Bunni@Neh.10.15.description: Bunni was one of the leaders of the people who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.
Bunni@Neh.10.15.name: Bunni

Bunni@Neh.11.15.description: Bunni, a Levite, was a resident of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.
Bunni@Neh.11.15.name: Bunni

Bunni@Neh.9.4.description: Bunni, a Levite, was among those who led the people in confessing their sins during the time of Nehemiah.
Bunni@Neh.9.4.name: Bunni

Buz@1Ch.5.14.description: Buz, a descendant of Gad, was the son of Abdiel and the father of Jahdo.
Buz@1Ch.5.14.name: Buz

Buz@Gen.22.21.description: Buz was the son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and the father of the Buzites.
Buz@Gen.22.21.name: Buz

Buz@Jer.25.23.description: Buz was an Arabian tribe, possibly descended from Nahor, that was threatened with judgment.
Buz@Jer.25.23.name: Buz

Buzi@Ezk.1.3.description: Buzi, a priest, was the father of Ezekiel the prophet.
Buzi@Ezk.1.3.name: Buzi

Buzites@Job.32.2-.description: The Buzites were descendants of Buz, the son of Nahor, Abraham's brother.
Buzites@Job.32.2-.name: Buzites
